reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for L-carnitine, or for any supplement. In general terms, it's an amino acid derivative that's sold for fat metabolism and recovery. The research on it is mixed, and it does nothing to replace consistent training, enough protein and enough food.

Whether it's worth taking at all, and how much, is one for a doctor or a registered dietitian, especially if you take any medication or have a health condition. I'm glad to help with the training side whenever you want to get into it.
